correctness.rationale: The ℓ1² fiber optimization for z=(α,1−α), 0<=α<=1/2, proves m_z(a)=1+max{0,a−2α}, 0<=a<=1, using attained two-sign witnesses and casewise ℓ1 upper bounds. With a=||yγ||_1, all other ℓp mass equals 1−a^p, so the min-chord pth power is 1−a^p+m_z(a)^p. It is maximized at a=0 or 1, yielding max{2,(2−2α)^p}. A fresh outer coordinate gives σ(x)>=2^(1/p) for arbitrary x and balanced z attains equality. Independently checked 16 fiber/outer exponent combinations by bounded numerical optimization; analytic casework proves all real p>=1.
